description.en: Pervasive disregard for and violation of the rights of others since age 15
description.hi: 15 वर्ष की आयु से दूसरों के अधिकारों की व्यापक अवहेलना एवं उल्लंघन

mappingNote: ICD-11 does not carry a distinct Antisocial Personality Disorder category; the closest comparison is 6D12 Dissociality pattern qualifier within personality disorder diagnosis (severity must be established first, Rule 5). DSM conduct-disorder history before age 15 has no automatic ICD equivalent - assess each system independently.
